text: Iote is a background character from the Archanea Series. He was the first king of Macedon. He was originally one of many slaves deported to the undeveloped forests of Macedon by the Dolunian Empire. He opposed the Empire and managed to escape from the forests along with some companions. Afterwards, he fought against the Empire by mounting wild Wyverns as steeds and using his shield. After Dolhr fell, the slaves claimed Macedon, now a rich and newly developed land, as their own and Iote was their natural choice for king. Iote's Shield became the Macedonian royal family's treasure. His descendant, Michalis, is said to be his second coming.

Janaff is a playable character from Fire Emblem: Path of Radiance and Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn. Due to possessing an impeccable sense of sight, he thus serves as the 'eyes' of the Hawk King Tibarn. Janaff is also a good friend of Ulki's. Janaff's appearance belies his actual age of 110 years, causing him to often be mistaken for a child.
Laura is a playable character from Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn. She is a cleric from Daein.

The , or LRAD, is a type of sonic weapon appearing in Call of Duty: Black Ops III. According to Call of Duty's Twitter page, "Riot police have dispersed rioting mobs to the southwest of Chinatown using LRAD sonic area control weapons."

Krisheena is a playable character from TearRing Saga: Utna Heroes Saga. She is both a swordfighter and a thief. She is searching for the legendary ☆Dakruon in order to revive her deceased lover, Aldo. Krisheena can be duplicated through the use of a glitch.

Lucius is a playable character in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade. He is a Monk who follows the religion of Saint Elimine, and is deeply devoted to his best friend Raven. Due to his feminine appearance, he is often mistaken for being female.

Saint Macuil is a character from Fire Emblem: Three Houses. He was one of the Four Saints. It is said that his gift for strategy was unparalleled. He served as the chief tactician for Seiros and was a pioneering figure for and master of the magical arts.

The L3FT.E is a melee weapon in Call of Duty: Black Ops III that was added in the October 17, 2016‎ update. It is the left arm of a mannequin from Nuk3town that the player holds with both of their hands.
Natasha is a playable character from Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones. She is a cleric from the Grado Empire.

Muarim is a playable character from Fire Emblem: Path of Radiance and Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn. He is a Tiger Laguz, and is a former slave of the Beorc race. Muarim acts as a father-figure and best friend to Tormod, and fight the Begnion Occupational Army to liberate enslaved laguz.

The Mogall is an enemy-only Monster class that is first introduced in Fire Emblem Gaiden. Demented eyeballs given life through fell magic, Mogalls employ either Axes or Dark magic as their weapon of choice.
The LV8 Basilisk is an assault rifle in Call of Duty: Black Ops III, made available in Supply Drops on December 9th, 2016.

:For the similarly named Three Houses character, see here. Rafiel is a playable character from Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn. He is the first prince of Serenes, the lost heron country that was crushed by the Begnion Empire. He is the only heron who is not introduced in Fire Emblem: Path of Radiance, but is the first playable in Radiant Dawn. Much like all other heron Laguz, he is unable to fight, and can only sing galdrs to support other units in battle.

Rinecok is a boss character in Fire Emblem: Thracia 776. He is a member of the Loptr Church who presides over the Loptr monastery in the Dark Forest of Melfiye and guards the captive Miranda. When Leif and his army march through the forest, he orders his forces to engage them while he attempts to bewitch them with his Berserk. He also is forced to look after Sara, and tries in vain to prevent her from wandering out into the battlefield.

Uhai is an enemy character from Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade. He is one of the original members of The Black Fang, known as the Soaring Hawk. He hails from Sacae. In the Final Chapter, he appears as a morph wielding the Rienfleche.

The Lawn Mower is a weapon featured in the Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare Zombies map, Rave in the Redwoods. The Lawn Mower can be acquired via the various Totems available around the map. It is obtained by depositing one purple crystal, and two blues. It acts in a similar way to the Smiley, allowing it to be used a Melee weapon, or as a trap if if placed on the ground.
The Wild Demonic Beast is a class that first appears in Fire Emblem: Three Houses. They are Demonic Beasts that have become feral and infused with powerful poison.

Tài Fēng () :Tai Feng was a pupil of Liu Xuanxin and senior to Liu Zongwu. He traveled to Japan to challenge Tesshin Kasumi to a duel. A young Kenshiro Kasumi greeted him at the Hokuto Temple three times, each time lying to Tai Feng that the master was out. On that final time, Kenshiro taunted Tai Feng and provoked him into a fight, with Kenshiro easily evading all his attacks.

: The Search Captain was an officer of Golan, who only appears in the TV series. He was sent to hunt down "the Man with Seven Scars" after the death of The Major. He visits the oasis city and takes Rima's parents hostage as bait to lure out Kenshiro. However, Kenshiro arrives too late to save the two hostages who are slain by the captain. : The Search Captain's troops are wiped out by Kenshiro, and the terror-stricken captain makes a desperate lunge only to get kicked to the face. He begs for mercy and flees in his vehicle, unaware his vital point has already been struck, until his head explodes and he crashes into a ball of flames.

Kugelblitz ("Bullet Blitz") is a Blitz featured in Call of Duty: WWII Nazi Zombies, requiring 2,000 Jolts. With this Blitz, all of the player's ballistic weaponry is granted double damage, as well as an increased fire rate, similarly to Double Tap Root Beer 2.0 and Bang Bangs.
Shogun 'Brella is a Glider in Fortnite, that could have been be obtained by achieving a Victory Royale in Chapter 6: Season 1.
Swordmaster Ken is a in Fortnite: Save the World. He is a part of the [https://fortnite.fandom.com/wiki/Category:Core_Heroes Core Heroes] Set.

Mara Junot is a renowned Los Angeles-based voiceover specialist with a 3-dimensional voice that resonates for the most recognizable brands around the globe. From feature films to AAA video games, animation to promos, Mara's colorful vocal versatility dubbed her as a voiceover "Shapeshifter" who has been regularly featured on popular networks and titles worldwide for over a decade, including: Call of Duty, Destiny 2, Genshin Impact, Fortnite, Mortal Kombat 11 and MK 1, League of Legends, God of War: Ragnarök, DreamWorks, E!, History Channel, Lifetime, WEtv, The Walking Dead (Telltale Games), World of WarCraft, and many, many more. Mara is represented by DPN Talent (Los Angeles), Buchwald (New York) and Jason Marks Talent Management. Mara's voice and likeness was used for the Valkyrie, Mist in God of War Ragnarök.
The Koshka is a bullpup, straight-pull bolt-action sniper rifle featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 4 and Call of Duty: Mobile.
Wandering Souls are skinless, lost souls, which are the size of a normal human.

Alesha (A-lesh-a) Who Smiles at Death was a khan in the past of Tarkir. She ruled over the Mardu Horde with an iron fist and a steel blade. Seeing her charge into battle is enough to make warriors who were out of the fight rise and enter the fray once more.
Braids was a powerful — and very mad — dementia caster for the Cabal on Dominaria. She was later resurrected as a nightmare during the second Phyrexian Invasion.
The is a light machine gun that was added to Call of Duty: WWII with the 1.24 patch update on June 4th, 2019.

Black-Nose was a nezumi ninja, one of the group of wanderers trapped by the kami in a castle with Keimi the Minamo mage, Hojo the samurai, Saite the orochi archer, and Niseno the yamabushi shaman, who was in fact Sakashima. His ninjutsu skills helped the whole group survive the kami's siege.
Bruse Tarl, Boorish Herder is a human warrior ally from Zendikar.
Chaeska, Keeper of Tresserhorn, was the strongest of Lim-Dûl's undead minions during the Ice Age of Dominaria.
The is an assault rifle featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War, Call of Duty: Mobile, and Call of Duty: Black Ops 6.
Davvol was the first evincar to rule the artificial plane, Rath.
Damia, Sage of Stone is a legendary gorgon wizard from an unknown plane.
Dennick Betzold was a human soldier, and a son of bishop Worrin Betzold. After his death he became a spirit soldier. He was a native of Gavony, Innistrad.

Law Breaker is a Wildcard featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War. Law Breaker allows the player to equip any weapon class in the primary or secondary slot, and also to equip multiple perks from one Perk Category.
Damir, called the Voidwielder, is a guildless wizard on Ravnica. At one point he was on an Azorius list of the ten most wanted criminals, as a renegade mage with a vendetta against humanity.

Eldrazi is a creature type describing an ancient race native to the Blind Eternities that have neither physical form nor color alignment. Their nature is ceaseless hunger, so they travel between planes devouring the mana and life energy until the plane's destruction. Three Eldrazi titans were previously bound on Zendikar: Emrakul, Ulamog, and Kozilek. Emrakul warps biology, Ulamog warps physical properties, and Kozilek warps reality.
Drana is the last surviving bloodchief of the Kalastria, the wealthiest and most powerful of the vampire families of Malakir on Zendikar.
The LC10 is a submachine gun featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War, Call of Duty: Black Ops 6 and Call of Duty: Mobile.
Elsi Rimehit was an 8-year old girl who was bitten by a werewolf and possibly executed by cathars of the Church of Avacyn on the plane of Innistrad.
Esior is a Bird from an unknown plane, and a Mage's familiar.
Emry, Lurker of the Loch, is a merfolk wizard from Eldraine.

The Krasny Soldat (Russian: Красный Солдат, lit. Red Soldier), also referred to as Mech Z in the game files is an Elite Class enemy featured in Outbreak and Mauer der Toten within Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War Zombies mode.
Euroakus is a legendary treefolk wizard from an Earth-like plane.
Feldon was an important archeologist, linguist, glaciologist, and mage during the Brothers' War on Dominaria.

Fiers was a dwarf, revered as a god by Dominaria's dwarves and the Barbarian tribes on the Otarian continent of that plane. He was summoned by Karona as the deity of red magic, and might have been a planeswalker.
The [https://www.thefirearmblog.com/blog/2017/01/31/lapa-sm-modelo-3-smg-guns-nelmo-suzano/ LAPA] is a submachine gun featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War and Call of Duty: Mobile.
Garruk (pronounced GAIR-ruck), called the Wildspeaker, is a planeswalker with warrior-druid abilities and a special affinity with animals and beasts.

Florin Ozbolt is a former Simic scientist who turned himself into Experiment One. As a human, he was an older man, slight and disheveled, with an impressive pair of eyebrows, thinning hair, and a stubbly chin. Until his transformation, he had an apprentice named Liana.
Fire Eye was the Viashino Bey of Shiv in 3346 AR, when Urza came to take control of the Mana Rig.
The is an assault rifle featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III and Call of Duty: Mobile.

Geth was a Moriok lich-head who was instrumental in the fall of Memnarch. He was one of the Seven Steel Thanes of New Phyrexia, known as the Thane of Contracts, before being Compleated fully into the Phyrexian Insect Vishgraz by Ixhel.

The Great Spirit was a Force of Nature from the White Woods of Corondor on Dominaria. The Calthyn elves and the Kieryn elves fought each other for the privilege to speak with it. Everything it touched as it watched the battle between the Calthyn and Kieryn elves shriveled and died. It told Jared Carthalion that Ravidel was alive, and that he sought Liana and her Moxen.

Gorgons, also known as medusae, are snake-skinned humanoid women with hair made of snakes or snakelike tendrils. Incredibly deadly, these creatures are rare across the various planes. Gorgons have the ability to calcify organic entities that look at the gorgon's face. The transformation is rapid, leaving the victim as a stone statue, usually frozen in a position of abject fear or agony- a fine trophy for the gorgon's macabre collection. The gorgon must exert its will to effect this transformation, so the gaze of a surprised or friendly gorgon is harmless. Only rare, powerful magic can reverse petrification (usually resulting in a well-preserved corpse), and it is irreversible if the victim statue is broken beyond repair. The first creature to bear the creature type was Masked Gorgon in Judgement, though the Infernal Medusa from Legends was later issued errata in the Grand Creature Type Update to become a Gorgon instead of a Medusa. Mechanically, Gorgons tend to either have deathtouch, or an ability that destroys creatures - of those without access to deathtouch, three have deathtouch variants, and five others destroy creatures in other ways. They also tend to have lower power and higher toughness.
The is a marksman rifle featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II. The LM-S is also available in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III as part of the Modern Warfare II content carryover.

Ghalma, the Shaper, is a loxodon artificer from Mirrodin. Metal seems to flow like a liquid under her touch, allowing her to sculpt metal objects without a forge. She uses this power to craft toys, trinkets, and small artifact creatures. Ghalma survived the advent of New Phyrexia and is responsible for creating Razor Circle Passages used by survivors in the Razor Fields to access other refugees in the Furnace Layer.
Geralf III Cecani (Gehr-alf Seh-sahn-nee) is a blue-aligned necromancer from Innistrad. He has a rivalry with his twin sister Gisa Cecani.
King Glarb, also referred to as His Moistness, is a frogfolk from Bloomburrow. He is king of the frogfolk and a powerful wizard.
The , also called JLTV, is a vehicle featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III, and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4.

Hunding Gjornersen was the first leader of the Dominarian band of thieves known as Robaran Mercenaries, scouting the Jamuraan seas around the 3300s AR. Since anyone could challenge him for leadership of the Robaran anytime, he was often forced to use his fists as a means of command. His ship was named Stangg's Talon. Despite his terrifying sight, he was as charming a companion as one could wish for. Sometime later, he quit for unknown reasons. His lieutenant, Adira Strongheart, took command, reforming the thieves' band into a motley mercenary army.

Hazoret is the Jackal-headed Amonkheti god of zeal. She was responsible for the final trial and slaughtered the winner with her spear, rewarding them with the God-Pharaoh's presence. After the Hour of Devastation she became known as the God-Survivor.

Gyruda is a legendary demon kraken from the plane of Ikoria that churns up the sea with death and insanity. Gyruda is known to feast on trade ships by the sailors of an Ikorian coastal town. The planeswalker Vivien Reid, attracted by the tales of the demonic kraken, tried to charter a boat to investigate, but she couldn't find any willing captains. Vivien wonders if the monster is the fated companion of a bonder. Gyruda fought in defense of Ikoria during New Phyrexia's Invasion of the Multiverse.
The is a bolt-action sniper rifle featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II. The LA-B 330 is also available in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III as part of the Modern Warfare II content carryover.
Haldan is a Human Wizard from Ikoria. He is bonded with the monstrous Elemental Dog Pako.
Jarsyl was a powerful wizard from Dominaria at the outset of the Dark Age.

Jamil was a powerful wizard from an unknown plane and archenemy to the wizard Nevar. He summoned Caliphear the Nightmare to kill Nevar when the battle had finally come to a standstill. He returned Caliphear to Dominaria once she had destroyed Nevar and his army.

Lachmann & Meer, sometimes called Lachmann & Meer Arsenal, abbreviated as LM, is a weapon manufacturer in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4. Their logo is the letter LM with occular lens over it.
Isareth the Awakener is a legendary human wizard from an unknown plane.
Dean Imbraham is a bird wizard teacher at the Quandrix College of Strixhaven University on Arcavios.
Ishkanah, also known as the Broodmother or Grafwidow, is a spider of Innistrad.
La Sous Terre (French for "The Underground"), abbreviated as LST, is a French weapon manufacturer in Call of Duty: Mobile.

Jessie Zane is a human assassin from an unknown plane who arrived on Thunder Junction after the Omenpaths opened. She is familiar with Amonkhet. Jessie brings the the Bite of Rhonas to lands that have never known his name.
Indris is a legendary otterfolk incarnation from Bloomburrow.
Isak Glen'Dard was a shapeshifter messenger, diplomat and spy living in the Dark Age of Terisiare, on the plane of Dominaria.
The LW Silencer Barrel is a Signature Attachment for the UL736 light machine gun in Call of Duty: Mobile. It was added in January 2024 as part of the Season 1: Soldier's Tale update.
Kamahl was a powerful human barbarian from the Pardic Mountains of Otaria on Dominaria. He was the brother of Jeska and the pupil of Balthor.
Kess, Dissident Mage is a legendary human wizard from Alara.

Kadena is a naga wizard, belonging to the Silumgar brood of Tarkir in the altered timeline. Clever, canny, and shrewd, Kadena is always looking for a chance to claw her way to power within the brood. She maintains a network of spies who keep her informed of everything happening within the ranks of power. This hoard of information is kept in preparation for the day when she throws off all pretense and seizes power for herself.
The is a sniper rifle featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 6. Unlike other Sniper Rifles, it features a Variable Zoom optic by default.
Kaza is a human thrill seeker and master wizard from Zendikar. She is a member of the Sea Gate Expeditionary House.

Kequia is a human psychometrist and mage-student, originally from Dominaria, who studied at Strixhaven University on Arcavios during the Omenpath Era. She is the daughter of Niambi and granddaughter of Teferi Akosa.
Kianon was Freyalise's bonded wolverine during the Ice Age on on Dominaria. Kianon sacrificed itself to destroy the Giant Spider Seklistis during Freyalise's duel with Jason Carthalion at Storgard.
The is a submachine gun featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 6.
Kiki-Jiki (kee-kee JEE-kee; ) was an akki of Sokenzan on Kamigawa, who could duplicate creatures with a special brand of illusionism.
Kresh the Bloodbraided was the mightiest human warrior from Jund, Alara. He wore a sword called Mage Slayer and commanded respect and honor, and caused bloodshed wherever he went.

Kinnan, Bonder Prodigy, is a human druid on the plane of Ikoria. Kinnan is a very young bonder, considered a prodigy among them. This is because while most bonders have only one monster companion, some like Kinnan can bond with many. The planeswalker Vivien Reid tried to ask him how he did it, but he just growled at her before riding off on the back of one of his beasts. Having grown up with monsters, Kinnan doesn't know much about manners.
Lance Free Tactical, abbreviated as LFT, is a weapon manufacturer in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III.
Kolevi of Havenwood was an Elder Druid from Havenwood on Dominaria.
Khrad is the Prince of the Telu-Set and a mighty warrior from Muraganda.
The Lord of House Khone was a black-mana wizard knight of the Black Fortress in Arathoxia (Dominaria). He was also lord of House Khone of Khone Keep in the Khone swamp of Golthonor on Corondor.
The Kogot-7 is a submachine gun featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 7. It was added as part of the Season One update.
Lorthos was a monstrous octopus who lived in the oceans of Zendikar.

Lukka (Phyrexian: cyhYD, IPA: [lykuʔ]) was a red-aligned human Phyrexian Planeswalker from the plane of Ikoria. He was compleated during the events of Phyrexia: All Will Be One, and later killed by Vadrok and Vivien Reid during the siege of Ikoria as part of New Phyrexia's Invasion of the Multiverse.
Dean Lisette is a human druid teacher at the Witherbloom College of Strixhaven University on Arcavios.

The Lancer was a submachine gun that was featured in Call of Duty: Future Warfare. However, when Future Warfare was canceled, the Lancer was discarded as well, and was never ported to any other future titles.
Sabul Hajeen was a wizard, a Civic Guildmage, who summoned the angel Kotara to Zhalfir while it was part of the continent of Jamuraa on the plane of Dominaria.

Seton was a Centaur druid from the Krosan forest on Dominaria. A master healer and competent warrior, he was the Krosan centaurs' emissary to the outside world, as well as an accomplished pit fighter.
Seizan, Perverter of Truth, is a kami demon spirit from Kamigawa.
The is an American Recon Aircraft that saw service during World War II. It is featured in Call of Duty 2: Big Red One, Call of Duty: WWII and Call of Duty: Vanguard.

Sindoya was one of the Nekoru Wasitora's kittens on Dominaria. He had white and black fur. His name meant Warning Growl, for he liked to frighten people with his voice. He was bigger than Peribet, but not as strong or fast. Kolo Meha called him Buzzy, which he didn't like very much.

Tamiyo (; Phyrexian: temDwooD, IPA: [tamʔjoʊʔ]) was a Phyrexian Moonfolk planeswalker from Kamigawa. She was the wife of Genku and the mother of Hiroku, Rumiyo, and Nashi. She was killed by The Wanderer while leading the attack on Kamigawa during New Phyrexia's Invasion of the Multiverse and returned as an animated story scroll.
Storrev is a Devkarin elven lich and leader of the Erstwhile, a zombie faction within the Golgari Swarm of Ravnica.

The [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/LCVP_(United_States) LCVP Higgins Boat] is an American landing craft used extensively by the Allied forces in amphibious landings in World War II in battles like Operation Husky, Normandy Landings and the Battle of Peleliu. It appears in Call of Duty 2, Call of Duty 2: Big Red One, Call of Duty: World at War (Nintendo DS), Call of Duty: WWII, Call of Duty Mobile and Call of Duty: Vanguard.
Stephan, also referred to as It Came from Planet Glurg, is an alien ooze who resides in Myra the Magnificent's Intergalactic Astrotorium of Fun.
Tadeas, Juniper Ascendant, is a legendary human monk from Dominaria.

Teysa Karlov is the Matriarch of the Karlov family, current guildmaster of the Orzhov Syndicate, and the wealthiest individual on Ravnica. She was assassinated around 10,080 ZC as part of a Ravnican crime wave. She returned as a spirit after the case was resolved to once again lead the Orzhov.

The (LST) is an American Landing Craft that was designed to ferry large vehicles and other smaller craft in amphibious landings during World War II in battles like the Battle of Betio, Battle of Saipan, Battle of Okinawa, Battle of Peleliu and the Normandy Landings. They appear in Call of Duty: World at War, Call of Duty: World at War: Final Fronts, Call of Duty: WWII, Call of Duty: Mobile and Call of Duty: Vanguard.
Thallids are fungus creatures created by infusion with green mana, specific to the Magic: The Gathering Multiverse. All Thallids have the Fungus subtype.
Tezzeret (/tɛzɜrɛt/) is a male human planeswalker, born in Tidehollow on the shard of Esper (Alara). He was a henchman of Nicol Bolas but despised his master.
Terrik is an elven wurmcaller, part of the Selesnya Conclave on the plane of Ravnica.

The Lanchester is a submachine gun that appears in Call of Duty: World at War (Nintendo DS) and used only by the British faction in multiplayer as one of the two SMGs of the British faction, the other being the Sten MK II. It has a 32 rounds magazine, decent rate of fire and medium recoil, which can be easily countered by aiming downwards while firing.

Towser was an egoistic wizard interested in astronomy and astrology, living on Aerona (Dominaria). He was the main foe of Greensleeves and Gull. He hired Gull as a member of his traveling crew to tend his livestock and wagons. After he had gathered a group of wizards who were once defeated by Greensleeves, he forced her via the Stone Brain to be obedient and planned to kill her. After Greensleeves defeated him yet again she found a terrifying punishment for Towser. With the Coral Helm she took away his gift of doing magic. Tower used all colors of magic except white: blue (Unsummon, Mahamoti Djinn), green (Regeneration, Wall of Brambles), red (hydra, berserkers) and black (Pestilence).

The Wanderer is a former planeswalker introduced in War of the Spark. She is the current Emperor of Kamigawa, and one of the most efficient and deadly warriors seen on any plane. She lost her spark during the Desparkening, but unlike her fellow planeswalkers, this was a great benefit to her.

Transmogrants were artifact zombies created by Ashnod during the Brothers' War on Dominaria. They were eyeless attack units created from the bodies of those who died in combat, of sickness, or refused to serve. Though mass-produced, each one seemed to have a unique body, a one-off marriage of dead flesh and iron. The soulless transmogrants had dead and graying skin, stretched and woven through dark metal. They walked without outward care of the cold. They carried no weapons, but wicked claws burst from weeping stumps. Bloodless flaps with dead tufts of hair pulled taught over polished metal domes. Chain veils hid the ruins of faces. A living specimen, too grotesque and unpredictable to display, was preserved beneath the museum at the College of Lat-Nam.

LSW may refer to the: *L86 LSW - A light machine gun in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3, Call of Duty Online, Call of Duty: Mobile and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare. *QBB LSW - A light machine gun in Call of Duty: Black Ops II, Call of Duty: Mobile and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III. *Kastov LSW - A light machine gun in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III.
Vial Smasher the Fierce is a legendary goblin berserker from Tarkir.
Vadmir is a vampire rogue from an unknown plane who arrived on Thunder Junction after the Omenpaths opened.

Vor Golozar was a Gruul raid captain from the Utvara reclamation zone on Ravnica. When the lokopede vehicle of Teysa Karlov was attacked by possessed Gruul, Golozar rescued/captured Crix. Later, he was ordered to accompany her to the Cauldron. Pursued by the same possessed Gruul who attacked the lokopede, Golozar and Crix met Agrus Kos and Pivlic. The four were captured and imprisoned almost instantly after Crix delivered her message. After he was freed from his tethers, Golozar attacked Hauc and almost killed him. When the magelord managed to control one of the newborn dragons, Golozar helped Teysa by riding the other. In the end, the pair was able to defeat Hauc and his dragon. Golozar then steered their dragon to a sharp outcrop, preventing the beast from ever getting out of control by killing her. After the dragon danger was neutralized, Golozar was appointed to be the new Minister of Security in Teysa's service. It is unknown whether Golozar survived the rampage of the nephilim during the events of Dissension. Kos's memories hint that Golozar used to live in the city itself and was even trained for wojek service. However, he left both the academy and the city for living as a wild Gruul, for unknown reasons.

Last Chance is the final level in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare: Mobilized. The player must fight their way through the facility with Capt. Bell and Sgt. Walker to de-activate a nuclear device. The player plays as Sgt. Patrick O'Neil.
Voja Fenstalker is a massive white wolf, and the former companion of the elven evangelist Tolsimir Wolfblood of the Selesnya Conclave on Ravnica.

Wryget was a Shadowmoor merrow, a skilled tideshaper, and a member of Sygg's pirate crew. He was spared by Jack Chierdagh when the kithkin attacked Sygg's crew. Later, he worked for Brigid Baeli. He helped to defend Mistmeadow and participated in the ambush of Ashling the Destroyer near Kinscaer. He survived the Maralen-Oona war, but his current whereabouts are unknown.
Vorinclex (Phyrexian: lornScs, IPA: [vornχlx]), called The Voice of Hunger, was the Green-aligned praetor of New Phyrexia.

Kryptek can refer to several weapon camouflages: *Kryptek: Typhon in Call of Duty: Black Ops II. *Kryptek Highlander in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare. *Kryptek Neptune in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare. *Kryptek Raid in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare. *Kryptek Yeti in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare.
Vorel of the Hull Clade is a human / merfolk hybrid biomancer from the Simic Combine on Ravnica.
Xeddick was a small, sickly-looking dead-white kraul from Ravnica, with drooping, useless wings. He was the size of a small pony. Xeddick was a close ally of the Golgari queen Vraska.

Yert was a Moriok from the Mephidross on Mirrodin. Yert had orders from Geth to kill Glissa Sunseeker during her trip into the Dross. When Glissa, Slobad and Bosh slaughtered Yert's Reaper, a very powerful zombie, Glissa felt sorry when Yert broke down crying as a result. Yert agreed to help her achieve her goals so long as she would help him get a new zombie to control. Geth, angered at Glissa's impertinence, ordered his pet vampire to attack, which she defeated after grievously wounding it. With no choice, Geth told Glissa what she wanted to know which got her to leave more quickly. Unfortunately, the vampire's wounds were severe and only an extensive feeding would save it. So Yert was fed to the vampire, ensuring the traitor's death. He did not stay dead, unfortunately, and rising as a vampire himself he overthrew Geth after beheading him.

The (directly translated as "Air Weapon" in German) is the aerial warfare branch of the German Military, and appears in Call of Duty, Call of Duty: United Offensive, Call of Duty 2, Call of Duty: Big Red One, Call of Duty 3, Call of Duty: Roads to Victory, Call of Duty: World at War, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3, Call of Duty: WWII, Call of Duty: Vanguard.

Zaala is a noble paladin on Shandalar, daugher of lord Alcinore. She and her father are famous for having slain the dragon known as the Scourge of Valkas. Her hair has been cut short to fit in a knight's helmet, and she wears a full set of armor and a lance when she charges into battle.

The Hazardous Environment Combat Unit Medic, commonly abbreviated as the HECU Medic, is an HECU class formally introduced as an ally in Half-Life: Opposing Force. He is trained in first aid and emergency surgery and has the ability to heal wounded soldiers in the field.

B-010-233 was the EC# for a certain Jiralhanae. His red headdress and gravity hammer signify a high rank in Jiralhanae wartime society, although his prowess as a soldier is debated. B-010-233 was killed by SMG fire soon after reaching the peak of this ravine. There are no UNSC killed or wounded attributed to his actions. Strangely, there was a Marine right about to be smashed by his hammer, although the reports claimed that no one was killed, so the Marine seemingly survived what is usually a fatal injury.
Lieutenant Leonov (Russian: Леонов) was a Red Army officer in the 13th Guards Rifle Division with Private Vasili Ivanovich Koslov.

Anglers were a species of highly intelligent bipedal reptilians found on Erebus VII. They were responsible for wiping out several ONI bases on the planet and were named ‘Anglers’ by the Human survivors. Anglers spit a film like substance into the eyes of their victims, which acts as a calming agent, rendering the victim immobile but keeping them content.
The alchemically-enhanced soldier, Kolby is a Commander of a battalion of the Unified Nations Security Confederation's (UNSC) SKY MARSHAL ASTRO-RANGERs during the Final War against The Covenant.
A Metarch-class Ancilla was a designation of Forerunner Artificial intelligence. 032 Mendicant Bias was a Metarch-class Ancilla, and was tasked with governing the original Halo Installations.

Sergeant Lev Kuznetsov (Russian: Лев Кузнецов) is a Red Army tank commander who participated in Operation Little Saturn during World War II, as seen in Call of Duty: Finest Hour. In Operation Little Saturn, after some T-34 tanks broke through the eastern gate to the German-held Tatsinskya airfield, Kuznetsov reported that his tank needed repair and that he and his crew were going to stop inside a warehouse to do some repairs mid-battle. Maj. Badanov, also needing to make repairs to his tank, followed Kuznetsov into the warehouse.
A cherot was a creature native to Reach prior to its glassing in 2552. Cherots possessed gossamer wings with which they could flit about.

Estey-Bethel was a SPARTAN-IV supersoldier who served with Fireteam Castle on the . In February 2558, Estey-Bethel and the rest of Fireteam Castle were killed after their Pelican was shot down by Jul 'Mdama's forces while on a supply run to Copernicus Base.
Floats Near Ceiling was a Huragok that served with the Covenant during the early years of the empire.
The is a German main battle tank and appears in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3.
Garrett B. is a Spartan-IV supersoldier. Their service number is 72895-15150-GB. They graduated from the Avery J. Johnson Academy of Military Science.
The Phylarch of Builders was a powerful Forerunner official of Builder rate. The Phylarch had the power to revoke and reinstate entire rates. He was responsible for reinstating the Warrior-Servants.

Vice Admiral Preston Jeremiah Cole (service number 03956-26127-PC) was a human officer of the UNSC Navy who served during both the Insurrection and the Human-Covenant War. Cole is best known for being the commander of the majority of the UNSC Navy from 2525 until 2543 and for his role in creating the Cole Protocol, a central UNSC law responsible for defending Earth's location for decades. A military genius, he defeated the Covenant in every major battle he fought and his battle record was considered to be without equal, even more impressive than that of the Spartan-IIs. Originally born on a small farm on Earth, Cole eventually enlisted in the UNSC Navy and quickly accelerated through the ranks after his graduation at the Luna OCS Academy. As the Insurrection began, Cole was hailed as a hero throughout human space by the Navy as he led numerous battles and campaigns against insurrectionist and pirate forces. However, after beginning a relationship with Lyrenne Castilla—a rebel leader, unbeknownst to Cole—he was relegated to a desk job for the rest of the war, where he eventually retired and faded into relative obscurity. However, after the Human-Covenant War began in 2525, the Office of Naval Intelligence elected to have Cole lead a battle group against the Covenant at Harvest, leading to Cole's victory at the Battle of Harvest. For the following decades, Cole led numerous campaigns against the Covenant with moderate success. In 2543, at the Battle of Psi Serpentis, Cole was p

Sergeant Logan Walker is a playable character and the main protagonist of Call of Duty: Ghosts. He is David "Hesh" Walker's younger brother and Elias T. Walker's son. After passing all his tests on the battlefield, he becomes a member of the Ghosts after being rescued by them.
Rosado is a SPARTAN-IV supersoldier in the United Nations Space Command.
Si Wheeler, callsign Intrepid One, is a SPARTAN-IV supersoldier who served as team leader of Fireteam Intrepid in the United Nations Space Command.

Xelq 'Tylk is a Sangheili who served as the a scout-eye operator for Colony External Maintenance on the Refuge in 2553. He was once an up-and-coming floatfighter but gave it up to take the job. He is squat, stocky, and strong of arm. His mandibles are studded with bits of metal crafted from debris he found in the Refuge's debris field. By 2560, he joined the Swords of Sanghelios, serving aboard the Scorrin's Blade.

Leopard Personalization Pack is a downloadable content package available for Call of Duty: Ghosts. It contains a weapon camo, reticle, a player background and a player patch. Leopard Personalization Pack Detail CoDG.png|Pack Detail
Manny Gutierrez is a pilot who works with H.A.W.X. Squadron and was a mentor to Arrow in the near future. During one mission, he assisted by flying an Mi-24.

The Beast People were the minions of Beast Man and had orange fur similar to their leader's, although their faces were more feline in appearance. they occasionally ran on all fours and often climbed like apes, using their feet with as much dexterity as their hands.
A Darkstalker is a very dangerous Etherian snake with five heads. Shadow Weaver kept one under control with her dark magic inside Horror Hall.

Lightning Camouflage is a weapon camouflage in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare. It is available with the purchase of the Lightning Pack. It gives a weapon the appearance of being electrified. Bal-27 Lightning Camo AW.png|The camouflage applied to the Bal-27.
A Draco is a type of dragon-like beast on Eternia. They live in the underbrush of the Evergreen Forest.

The Cuja is an animal in the animated series The New Adventures of He-Man. The Cuja was a savage predator native to the ice planet Omega-4 in the Tri-Solar System. It resembled a cross between a lion and a bear. A Cuja attacked four Spiran children who had escaped from Maxis' slave labor camp, but they managed to escape into an ice cave. Sometime later, Caz of Primus was attacked by the same Cuja, and ended up sliding down into the same ice cave where the four children from the planet Spira.

Dagar's Guardians are magical creatures that appear in the animated series The New Adventures of He-Man. Dagar's Guardians were originally lifeless gargoyle statues decorating the bedposts in one of the guest rooms of Master Sebrian's Home When the wizard Dagar was challenged to a magic duel by the evil wizard Ramlin, Dagar used his powers to animate the statues]] on his bedposts, but realized to late that by having them attack Ramlin, he was allowing the evil wizard to absorb them as well as Dagar's powers. The next day, Ramlin even went as far as to use a projection of Dagar as well as his gargoyles, which he now identified as 'Dagar's Guardian's' against Zontos and Sebrian, but when He-Man realized that the only way to defeat Ramlin was not to attack him with magic, Ramlin was defeated and was forced to release his hold over Dagar.
The Locus is a bolt-action sniper rifle featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops III, Call of Duty: Black Ops 4, and Call of Duty: Mobile.

The Ice Monster is a creature in the animated series The New Adventures of He-Man. Two Ice Monsters were carved out of a wall of ice by the evil Maxis using a freeze ray from his vizor on the planet Omega-4. Maxis ordered his 'frigit friend' to attack He-Man and finish him off, but failed to realize that the children Caz and Brojee were behind him in the snow. The boy began to throw snowballs at Maxis, which caused him to lose control of where he was aiming his vizor and he inadvertedly began to carve up both of his Ice Monsters with the powerful laser beam. Later, as Maxis and Zark made ready to leav the planet, another three Ice Monsters were sent to attack the Galactic Guardians, but were swiftly defeated by Spinwit and Tuskador.

Queen Amaxa is the Queen of Tarn. She is King Randor's cousin. Their mothers were sisters. Queen Amaxa wore the Crown of Tarn, which possessed magic powers when worn by the rightful sovereign and prevented wars, riots and rebellious acts.

A Snow Leopard is a creature that appears in the animated series The New Adventures of He-Man. SNow Leopards lived in the Mountains of Zane on the planet Darius-7, where they were revered as a symbol of peace. When the painter Helm came to visit Master Sebrian on Primus, he gifted the master's assistant Mara with a painting of a Snow Leopard, painted with magical brushes given to Helm by his grandmother, an old acquantance of Sebrian. Mara confessed she had never seen anything like these paintings. The way they float in the air it almost seemed as if the subject were alive. She told Helm she would treasure it always. According to Gleep, the painter had used anti-graviatational pigment with a chemical interaction that allows it motion. Some time later, the evil Skeletor used a magic spell to make some of his own evil flow into Helm's paintings and make them come alive. He then commanded the creatures to go attack the inhabitants of Primus. Sebrian and Mara woon found themselves attacked by the Snow Leopard come to life. They managed to escape Master Sebrian's Home by confusing the creature with projections of themselves. Soon He-Man and Helm came to their rescue. While He-Man faced the Snow Leopard, Helm quickly fabricated a new painting, of a heroic archer, which he ordered to come alive and use it's bow and arrow to destroy the Leopard.
The is a weapon appearing as an assault rifle in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare and as a sniper rifle in Call of Duty: WWII. It also makes a brief appearance in Call of Duty: Black Ops III.

The Trumpet Birds live in the magical trees of Whispering Woods. The Trumpet Bird was a pecular kind of fowl with a beak that also served as a musical instrument. The creature was able to take in a large amount of air in one intake, swelling it's body up like a balloon in the process. It would then exhale and blow the air out through its beak, producing a melody as if being played by a trumpet. The Trumpet Bird most often employed this technique at the break of dawn, as a means to wake up all other living beings residing in the Whispering Woods.
, is the main protagonist of the spin-off series, Daisuki desu!! Mahou Tenshi Cosmos. She is a ordinary girl who gained the power to transform herself into the magical girl.
The Stalker is a medium-sized that comes from Stalker Lairs. These sly beasts will require one very skilled Helldiver to bring down.
Lucky 7 is an Epic gun perk that appears in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare, found on the EMC - Avalanche. It unloads half of the weapon's clip with a 7-round burst upon every shot.

The Spore Burst Hunter is a special mutation of the Hunter, caused by the ' prolonged exposure to The Gloom, causing them to gain a white carapace along with red, flesh-like undertones. They appear to have some kind of fungi growing from their head and the tips of their legs. Spore Burst Hunters were first encountered during the Gloom Expedition on Fori Prime in February of 2185; not yet classified as a separate strain, the spores produced from their bodies upon death were only a minor inconvenience. However, after April of 2186, it was noticed that the spores released by Spore Burst Hunters on death cause frenzy in other in contact with said spores. This warranted the its own classification, and in turn - tactics.

The Spore Burst Warrior is a special mutation of the Warrior, caused by the ' prolonged exposure to The Gloom, causing them to gain a white carapace with red, flesh-like undertones. They appear to have some kind of fungus growing from their head and the tips of their legs. Spore Burst Warriors were first encountered during the Gloom Expedition on Fori Prime in February of 2185; not yet classified as a separate strain, the spores produced from their bodies upon death were only a minor inconvenience. However, after April of 2186, it was noticed that the spores released by Spore Burst Warriors on death cause frenzy in other in contact with said spores. This warranted the its own classification, and in turn - tactics.

Captain Ed Roberts is a supporting antagonist in the Henry Stickmin Series. He is a major antagonist in Escaping the Prison, serving as the main antagonist in the "Badass Bust Out" ending, and an unseen major antagonist in every other pathway. He is the chief of police at West Mesa Penitentiary. He runs a tight ship and expects the best from all his cadets. He holds an M4A1 Carbine (AK-47 in the legacy version), which he uses to fight against prisoners who try to escape.
The Light Shield is a hero skill in Call of Duty: Heroes for ETH.3n.

Free Transform is an option in Completing the Mission during the "Cleaned 'em Out" pathway. Henry Stickmin can use this option while riding on top of the Toppat Train, which is approaching a tunnel. Henry uses Adobe Animate Tools to shrink himself in size so he can go through the tunnel along with the train. Once the train reaches the other end of the tunnel, Henry is restored to his normal size. This results in a success.

Power Jump is an option in Fleeing the Complex during the "Ghost Inmate" pathway. Henry Stickmin can use this option to reach the roof of the security office without being seen by a nearby guard. Henry leaps high into the air and lands perfectly on the ceiling without making any noise.

The Bodyguard, also known as the Ninja Girl, is a character and a boss in Hotline Miami and a posthumous minor character in Hotline Miami 2: Wrong Number. She served as The Father's primary bodyguard during 1989 and had a vague relationship with The Son, who seems to keep her smashed sunglasses and katana in 1991. She is the penultimate boss of Hotline Miami.
Low Rider is a Common Gun Perk that appears in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare, found upon certain weapon variants. It reduces hipfire spread while sliding for the weapon variant it is applied to.

Adams (アダムス, Adamusu) is a Zombie created by Dio Brando, whose only characteristic is a long sharp tongue, who lurks around Windknight's Lot. Formerly a human and villager of Windknight, the zombie meets the Joestar Group and after a brief conversation with Poco, tries to ambush the Group from behind. Jonathan easily kills him with a Ripple-infused kick.

Fujiko Fujiyama (藤山不二子 Fujiko Fujiyama) is the main character featured in the non-canon manga Fujiko´s Bizarre Worldy Wisdom. She is a Stand user, and wields the Stand, Bad Romance. She is also an inmate at Green Dolphin Street Prison who sells paintings to other inmates for money.

, also known as , and Fumi-kun, is a minor character who appears briefly during the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion. He is a teenager living in Morioh in 1941, who agrees to help Lucy Steel when she arrives to investigate the Locacaca. He is the grandson of Johnny Joestar and Rina Higashikata, and has an unnamed Stand that creates vines, similar to the original Joseph Joestar.

Lifelink is an Epic gun perk in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. It regenerates the entire magazine of a weapon if the player takes any damage from an enemy player. It only appears on the Epic variant of the DCM-8 shotgun, the DCM-8 Masochist. This weapon also has a double magazine capacity to 24 rounds. Lifelink once allowed the player to have an infinite magazine size at the expense that every shot would damage the player, however this was changed to regenerating magazine size if damaged in the February 3rd, 2017 patch. In Zombies mode however, it still has an unlimited magazine capacity at the expense of damaging the player.
is a minor antagonist featured in Stardust Crusaders. When the Joestar Group enters DIO's Mansion, he casts an illusion on it to make it look like a labyrinth to them but is quickly taken out.

is a secondary antagonist featured in the light novel El Aleph. He is a human trafficker and the closest confidant of Fernando Arjón. Wielding his Stand, La Casa Verde, Dos Santos can rapidly grow underground to manipulate trees.
The are tertiary antagonists featured in the sixth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stone Ocean. They are goats from the fairy tale that were manifested by Bohemian Rhapsody.

Lightweight Mold is a weapon attachment that appears in in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. It is available for the KBAR-32, Widowmaker and Kendall 44, to which it is an integral attachment. It allows the player to have increased mobility for the KBAR-32 and the Widowmaker and increased hip fire control for the Kendall 44 and the KBAR-32.

is the main antagonist of the short story "Pair Repair", part of the Thus Spoke Kishibe Rohan: Short Story Collection. At first, Michiyo appears as an elderly woman who has decided to open her garden to the public, causing Rohan Kishibe to pay a visit out of curiosity. However, it is later revealed that she is a vengeful ghost exploiting the power of the land in order to take revenge on her and her husband's killers.

The is an unnamed primary antagonist featured in the second chapter of Gorgeous Irene. She is a deadly hitwoman sent by Tony Bormont's crime syndicate to kill Irene Rapona. She wields a supernatural tattoo on her back that can manifest weapons and deadly insects.

, full name Tyrus Raymond Cobb, is the protagonist of , the second episode of The Lives of Eccentrics. He is an American player who played for the . Over the course of his career filled with controversies, he earned a place in the history of baseball as one of the greatest. Ty Cobb's unmatched skill and fierce personality led many to believe that he is possessed by a vengeful ghost.
The is a blunt club-like melee weapon featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare Remastered. It was added via update on March 14th, 2017.

Kenichi's version of Shigure's Kousaka Slash. This technique can be performed using an actual sword or in Kenichi's case, using a knife hand strike as a substitute. This technique is basically a downward slash with enough power to stun the opponent without killing them. Just like the Kousaka Slash, this technique can cut through the opponent's clothes.

A more powerful version of the Left Straight, Takeda strikes his opponent in the face with a punch that is just as fast as a Illusionary left, but with even more power to the punch then either of the two inherint techniques used to make this one technique. This move was seen during his second fight with Lugh.
*Name: Joharirasan Taipa *Martial Art Style: Kalarippayattu *User: Cyril Rahman Cyril lunges at his opponent with a powerful downward double knife hand strike towards the opponent's torso.

Liberty Strike was an event in Call of Duty: WWII, from July 2nd to July 24th, 2018. Liberty Strike brought four new weapons along with new camouflages, weapon charms, uniforms, a community challenge, and the return of Captain Butcher as the Quartermaster.
*Name: Hanuman Tawai Wan *Martial Art Style: Muay Boran *User: Agaard Jum Sai Agaard performs a flying double uppercut to the opponent's head and adds a spin to the punch for increased force.

Fa Mulan is a young woman from The Land of Dragons who is a party member in Kingdom Hearts II. Determined to bring honor to her family, particularly her ill father, Mulan cuts her hair, steals her father's armor and impersonates a soldier named Ping to join the army to defeat Shan-Yu. Mulan is a generally weak fighter to begin with as Ping, but eventually becomes a skilled warrior.

The Smoker is a Special Infected characterized by his extremely long tongue. The Smoker's tongue can be launched out of his mouth at high speeds towards a Survivor, and when it reaches one of them, it automatically wraps around the target's body and drags them back towards the Smoker, where he begins clawing them. If an obstacle is in the way, then the tongue tightens and begins to choke the target. The Smoker is voiced by [https://www.imdb.com/name/nm0666604/ Mike Patton].
The Light Mag is an attachment featured in Call of Duty: Mobile. It is exclusive to the Fennec submachine gun.

is the fifth in . She is the Shrine Keeper of the Shrine of Water. Agwanda is a blob of water who has control over all forms of water, including tears and dew drops. She guards the Shrine's Water of Life, and suspects Zelda has come to steal it. She is protected by three servants, the Kelpies, which must be defeated in order to reach the room where Agwanda lurks.

is a character in . He can be found in the . He has a combative personality and does not care if his opponents are small or big. Legendary Big Hitter Price - 6800 Health - 19 Strength - 19 Defense - 18

Aldon was a young man from a Dominarian fable who lost his castle to the wizard Dreygar in the Western Domains somewhere between the casting of the World Spell and Year One by the Reckoning of the Sages of Minorad. He summoned a vampire, a frozen shade, and a bog wraith to help him to regain his castle, and later summoned a Serra Angel, who showed him the beauty of the world; Dreygar then sent a fallen angel to seduce Aldon. Aldon, his creatures, and the Serra angel assaulted the castle; Aldon killed the fallen angel and Dreygar, and once again ruled his castle, using the power of the dark amulet.
The M-16 Stock is a stock attachment featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare and Call of Duty: Warzone. It is uniquely available to the M4A1 assault rifle.

Alesha (A-lesh-a) Who Smiles at Death was a khan in the past of Tarkir. She ruled over the Mardu Horde with an iron fist and a steel blade. Seeing her charge into battle is enough to make warriors who were out of the fight rise and enter the fray once more.

Arna Kennerüd was a prominent Kjeldoran skyknight during the during the Ice Age of Dominaria. By the time of the Thaw, she was promoted to skycaptain. By 4562 AR, her descendant Tura Kennerüd also serves as a skyknight, riding an aesthir that is directly descended from Arna's.
Amareth, known as the Lustrous, is a dragon from an unknown distant plane.

Long Shot is a Weapon Perk featured in Call of Duty: Mobile. The perk was initially exclusive to Camos from Epic rarity and above. Since the Season 9 Conquest, it is available to all assault rifles minus the Groza and Cronen Squall, as well as other listed compatible weapons.
Anara is a wolf beast from an unknown plane, and a Mage's familiar.

Anhelo was a vampire and the former crime-lord and boss of the Maestros family in New Capenna. He was the best assassin in the city but also an artist. He was compleated during New Phyrexia's Invasion of the Multiverse and killed by his daughter, Errant.
The Beast of the Hours was a cockatrice at Sarraza in Almaaz, on the plane of Dominaria.
The Light Truck is a vehicle featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War in the Fireteam and Outbreak modes. It was added as part of the Season Two update.
Braids was a powerful — and very mad — dementia caster for the Cabal on Dominaria. She was later resurrected as a nightmare during the second Phyrexian Invasion.

Black-Nose was a nezumi ninja, one of the group of wanderers trapped by the kami in a castle with Keimi the Minamo mage, Hojo the samurai, Saite the orochi archer, and Niseno the yamabushi shaman, who was in fact Sakashima. His ninjutsu skills helped the whole group survive the kami's siege.
Bruse Tarl, Boorish Herder is a human warrior ally from Zendikar.
Lengthened is an ammo type available in Call of Duty: Vanguard and Call of Duty: Warzone. It increases the gun's bullet velocity by 30% in Vanguard and 8% in Warzone during Season Four.

Brudiclad is a Myr-like compleated artifact creature who is able to meld flesh and metal in glorious harmony. During the Time Spiral crisis he was transported through a time rift from a possible future to Dominaria. That future came to pass when, during New Phyrexia's Invasion of the Multiverse, he fought on the side of the invaders.

Branko, known in later life as Branko One-Ear, was a guard at the Azorius Detention Compound on the plane of Ravnica. He stood over seven feet tall, with broad and muscular shoulders. He wielded a stun baton.
Bernatheen was a Wizard Savant before Reveka's time, who infamously made Eron the Relentless immortal and was turned into a werewolf by Baron Sengir.
The is a light machine gun featured in Call of Duty: Vanguard. It was added on October 6th, 2022 as part of the Season Five Reloaded update.
Chaeska, Keeper of Tresserhorn, was the strongest of Lim-Dûl's undead minions during the Ice Age of Dominaria.
Chatterfang, Squirrel General, is a squirrel warrior from an unknown plane.
Daria was a young human girl from Ulgrotha whose planeswalker's spark triggered early in life. She was recruited by Urza as one of the Nine Titans.

The Low Temp Laser is an Underbarrel attachment available uniquely for the EX1 Assault Rifle in Call of Duty: Vanguard. It helps to the enemy nameplate range but at the cost of the light from the weapon being visible to said enemies.
Devin was a Faerie Noble on Ulgrotha around the time of the Homelands (ca. 3800 AR).

Eliza, known as Eliza of the Keep, was a young human woman from Alara, dwelling on the shard of Grixis and the only still-living Necromancer baron of the plane. Her skin was pale and supple, but her neck had a faint purple hue to it, possibly from some past injury. She ruled as baron of the Keep at Ilsun Gate in the Dregscape, and later of Unx itself. Eliza routinely requires the vis of the living to retain her vitality, so her legions are constantly scouting for villages and raiding ogre lairs.
Elsi Rimehit was an 8-year old girl who was bitten by a werewolf and possibly executed by cathars of the Church of Avacyn on the plane of Innistrad.

Long Range is a weapon mod featured in the Battle Royale mode of Call of Duty: Mobile. The Legendary variant grants a 1.5x headshot damage bonus. For example, an Oden equipped with a Legendary Long Range mod will deal 108 headshot damage instead of 72 headshot damage by default.

Ezuri was a one time elven bandit who turned into a hero after the Phyrexian compleation of Mirrodin. Although he was among the first on the plane to detect the invasion, he ultimately fell to the Progress Engine and was compleated himself. Now, Ezuri is a cunning, cold-hearted hunter who stalks the spheres and uses the knowledge of his former allies to capture them.
Euroakus is a legendary treefolk wizard from an Earth-like plane.
Feldon was an important archeologist, linguist, glaciologist, and mage during the Brothers' War on Dominaria.
The Longbow is a bolt-action sniper rifle featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III.
Gadwick, the Wizened, is a human wizard of Eldraine. He is the powerful and mysterious archmage of Vantress. He is the master of the apprentice mage Johann.

Geth was a Moriok lich-head who was instrumental in the fall of Memnarch. He was one of the Seven Steel Thanes of New Phyrexia, known as the Thane of Contracts, before being Compleated fully into the Phyrexian Insect Vishgraz by Ixhel.

Gorgons, also known as medusae, are snake-skinned humanoid women with hair made of snakes or snakelike tendrils. Incredibly deadly, these creatures are rare across the various planes. Gorgons have the ability to calcify organic entities that look at the gorgon's face. The transformation is rapid, leaving the victim as a stone statue, usually frozen in a position of abject fear or agony- a fine trophy for the gorgon's macabre collection. The gorgon must exert its will to effect this transformation, so the gaze of a surprised or friendly gorgon is harmless. Only rare, powerful magic can reverse petrification (usually resulting in a well-preserved corpse), and it is irreversible if the victim statue is broken beyond repair. The first creature to bear the creature type was Masked Gorgon in Judgement, though the Infernal Medusa from Legends was later issued errata in the Grand Creature Type Update to become a Gorgon instead of a Medusa. Mechanically, Gorgons tend to either have deathtouch, or an ability that destroys creatures - of those without access to deathtouch, three have deathtouch variants, and five others destroy creatures in other ways. They also tend to have lower power and higher toughness.
The is a light tank that appears in Call of Duty: WWII. The tank appears only as a prop in the maps Egypt, Excavation and Gibraltar. An anti aircraft version can also be found in the map Dunkirk.

Ghalma, the Shaper, is a loxodon artificer from Mirrodin. Metal seems to flow like a liquid under her touch, allowing her to sculpt metal objects without a forge. She uses this power to craft toys, trinkets, and small artifact creatures. Ghalma survived the advent of New Phyrexia and is responsible for creating Razor Circle Passages used by survivors in the Razor Fields to access other refugees in the Furnace Layer.

Goreclaw, Terror of Qal Sisma is a legendary bear, from Tarkir. Dragons rule the plane of Tarkir, but in the high forests of the Qal Sisma mountains, the great bear Goreclaw has survived long enough to rival the dragons in size and ferocity. When hunters venture too high into the mountains, they risk a deadly confrontation with the bear whose roar can shake the snow from the trees. During New Phyrexia's Invasion of the Multiverse, Goreclaw fought alongside Surrak against the invaders.

Hurkyl was a Master Wizard as well as one of the founders of the College of Lat-Nam and the Union of the Third Path during the Brothers' War on Dominaria. She was the wife of Drafna and played a major part in rediscovering magic on Terisiare.

Lightweight Hammer is an Epic gun perk in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. It is exclusive to the "Holliday" Prototype Weapon version of the Stallion .44. It allows the weapon to fire faster whilst aiming down sights, whilst also providing a unique scope optic.
Hekara was a cheerful Rakdos emissary and razorwitch on Ravnica. She was later transformed into a blood witch.
Helga is a frogfolk hedgewitch from Bloomburrow, and a member of Mabel’s party.
Jarsyl was a powerful wizard from Dominaria at the outset of the Dark Age.
The Lightweight Grip is a rear grip attachment featured in Call of Duty: Mobile, where it is available to the Type 19 assault rifle.
Ixidor was a powerful wizard and well-known pit champion from Dominaria.

Jamil was a powerful wizard from an unknown plane and archenemy to the wizard Nevar. He summoned Caliphear the Nightmare to kill Nevar when the battle had finally come to a standstill. He returned Caliphear to Dominaria once she had destroyed Nevar and his army.
Isareth the Awakener is a legendary human wizard from an unknown plane.

Lightwings Unbound (Ethan - Freedom Gundam Battle Theme) is the fourth track of the Call of Duty: Mobile Gundams Arrive Version (Original Game Soundtrack). It is composed by Tencent Games and [https://www.imdb.com/name/nm8906154 Kazuki Higashihara], with a runtime of 1:39.
Dean Imbraham is a bird wizard teacher at the Quandrix College of Strixhaven University on Arcavios.
Ishkanah, also known as the Broodmother or Grafwidow, is a spider of Innistrad.

Jessie Zane is a human assassin from an unknown plane who arrived on Thunder Junction after the Omenpaths opened. She is familiar with Amonkhet. Jessie brings the the Bite of Rhonas to lands that have never known his name.

The is a vehicle featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 and Call of Duty: Warzone 2.0. In Black Ops 7, it is available for use in Multiplayer within the Skirmish game mode, and in Warzone 2.0 as part of the Black Ops Royale game mode. In both modes, the Light Helicopter features a pilot seat and 4 passenger seats. A variant of the Light Helicopter was also available within the Heavy Metal Heroes mode of Warzone 2.0. The vehicle was coated with a prominent black coloring and featured only 2 passenger seats, one on each side, with each seat armed with an overheating Minigun.
Isak Glen'Dard was a shapeshifter messenger, diplomat and spy living in the Dark Age of Terisiare, on the plane of Dominaria.
Kamahl was a powerful human barbarian from the Pardic Mountains of Otaria on Dominaria. He was the brother of Jeska and the pupil of Balthor.
Karador Ghost Chieftain is a legendary centaur spirit from an unspecified plane.

The MG42 (Maschinengewehr 42) is a German machine gun that is featured in all of the World War II era Call of Duty installments, as well as making appearances in Call of Duty: Black Ops, Call of Duty: Black Ops III, Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War and Call of Duty: Mobile. In most games it is only mounted, but in Call of Duty: Finest Hour, Call of Duty: World at War (as well as Call of Duty: Zombies), Call of Duty: WWII, Call of Duty: Vanguard and Call of Duty: Mobile it is available as a portable weapon as well.
Kess, Dissident Mage is a legendary human wizard from Alara.

Kadena is a naga wizard, belonging to the Silumgar brood of Tarkir in the altered timeline. Clever, canny, and shrewd, Kadena is always looking for a chance to claw her way to power within the brood. She maintains a network of spies who keep her informed of everything happening within the ranks of power. This hoard of information is kept in preparation for the day when she throws off all pretense and seizes power for herself.
